nl_spec: Design an operational amplifier (differential input, single-ended output) in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: load capacitance 2 pF; a 10 uA reference current is available at ibias. Requirements: DC gain of at least 26 dB; unity-gain bandwidth of at least 43 MHz; phase margin of at least 70 degrees; 1% settling time for the large step of at most 33 ns; correct output polarity (1 = yes) of at least 1.

Design an operational amplifier (differential input, single-ended output) in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: load capacitance 2 pF; a 10 uA reference current is available at ibias. Requirements: DC gain of at least 63 dB; unity-gain bandwidth of at least 12 MHz; phase margin of at least 47 degrees; slew rate of at least 5.4 MV/s; correct output polarity (1 = yes) of at least 1.

Design an operational amplifier (differential input, single-ended output) in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: load capacitance 2 pF; a 10 uA reference current is available at ibias. Requirements: DC gain of at least 36 dB; unity-gain bandwidth of at least 93 MHz; phase margin of at least 70 degrees; slew rate of at least 37 MV/s; PSRR (VDD) at low frequency of at least 30 dB; output swing of at least 0.83 V; correct output polarity (1 = yes) of at least 1.

Design an operational amplifier (differential input, single-ended output) in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: load capacitance 2 pF; a 10 uA reference current is available at ibias. Requirements: DC gain of at least 72 dB; unity-gain bandwidth of at least 22 MHz; phase margin of at least 61 degrees; PSRR (VDD) at low frequency of at least 64 dB; slew rate of at least 14 MV/s; input-referred noise density at 1 kHz of at most 310 nV/sqrt(Hz); correct output polarity (1 = yes) of at least 1.

Design an operational amplifier (differential input, single-ended output) in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: load capacitance 2 pF; a 10 uA reference current is available at ibias. Requirements: DC gain of at least 65 dB; unity-gain bandwidth of at least 65 MHz; phase margin of at least 45 degrees; output swing of at least 1.09 V; total power consumption (including the reference current) of at most 710 uW; slew rate of at least 21 MV/s; correct output polarity (1 = yes) of at least 1.

Design a single-ended voltage amplifier in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: load capacitance 500 fF; input DC bias 0.75 V. Requirements: DC gain of at least -5 dB; -3 dB bandwidth of at least 790 MHz; gain-bandwidth product of at least 1.5 GHz; total power consumption (including the reference current) of at most 2.7 mW; output DC level between 0.45 V and 1.35 V.

Design a single-ended voltage amplifier in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: load capacitance 500 fF; input DC bias 0.75 V. Requirements: DC gain of at least 27 dB; -3 dB bandwidth of at least 11 MHz; output swing of at least 1.07 V; gain-bandwidth product of at least 450 MHz; total power consumption (including the reference current) of at most 440 uW; output DC level between 0.45 V and 1.35 V.

Design a single-ended voltage amplifier in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: load capacitance 500 fF; input DC bias 1.4 V. Requirements: DC gain of at least -7 dB; -3 dB bandwidth of at least 2.2 GHz; total power consumption (including the reference current) of at most 1.4 mW; gain-bandwidth product of at least 1.9 GHz; output swing of at least 0.44 V; output DC level between 0.45 V and 1.35 V.

Design a current mirror in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: input current 20 uA, target output current 20 uA (ratio 1) at 0.9 V. Requirements: output-current error relative to the target of at most 5 %; output resistance at the nominal output voltage of at least 330 kohm; output compliance voltage (minimum output voltage keeping >=95% of the current) of at most 0.49 V.

Design a current mirror in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: input current 20 uA, target output current 80 uA (ratio 4) at 0.9 V. Requirements: output-current error relative to the target of at most 3 %; output compliance voltage (minimum output voltage keeping >=95% of the current) of at most 0.31 V; output resistance at the nominal output voltage of at least 11 Mohm.

Design a current mirror in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: input current 20 uA, target output current 20 uA (ratio 1) at 0.9 V. Requirements: output-current error relative to the target of at most 3 %; output compliance voltage (minimum output voltage keeping >=95% of the current) of at most 0.19 V; output resistance at the nominal output voltage of at least 1.2 Mohm.

Design an active filter in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: lowpass response, stop frequency = 10 x fc. Requirements: -3 dB cutoff frequency between 152 MHz and 228 MHz; attenuation at the stop frequency of at least 17 dB; passband peaking of at most 2 dB; total power consumption (including the reference current) of at most 1.4 mW.

Design an active filter in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: lowpass response, stop frequency = 10 x fc. Requirements: -3 dB cutoff frequency between 2.16 MHz and 2.64 MHz; attenuation at the stop frequency of at least 45 dB; passband peaking of at most 2.6 dB; total power consumption (including the reference current) of at most 180 uW.

Design an active filter in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: bandpass response. Requirements: DC gain of at least -6 dB; centre frequency between 25.2 Hz and 30.8 Hz; total power consumption (including the reference current) of at most 390 uW.

Design a low-dropout linear regulator in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: load capacitance 1 nF; input 1.8 V, reference 0.6 V, target output 1.2 V, load current 50 uA to 5 mA, 10 uA bias current at ibias. Requirements: output-voltage error relative to the target of at most 5 %; load-step undershoot of at most 360 mV; PSRR at 1 kHz of at least 49 dB; quiescent current (at minimum load, including IREF) of at most 72 uA; residual ringing (peak-to-peak) 7-10 us after each load step of at most 10 mV.

Design a low-dropout linear regulator in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: load capacitance 1 nF; input 1.8 V, reference 0.6 V, target output 1.2 V, load current 50 uA to 5 mA, 10 uA bias current at ibias. Requirements: output-voltage error relative to the target of at most 3 %; load regulation of at most 1.1 V/A (= mV/mA); line regulation of at most 440 uV/V; load-step undershoot of at most 260 mV; quiescent current (at minimum load, including IREF) of at most 120 uA; PSRR at 1 kHz of at least 64 dB; residual ringing (peak-to-peak) 7-10 us after each load step of at most 10 mV.

Design a low-dropout linear regulator in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: load capacitance 1 nF; input 1.8 V, reference 0.6 V, target output 1.2 V, load current 50 uA to 5 mA, 10 uA bias current at ibias. Requirements: output-voltage error relative to the target of at most 3 %; quiescent current (at minimum load, including IREF) of at most 120 uA; load regulation of at most 1.2 V/A (= mV/mA); line regulation of at most 89 uV/V; load-step undershoot of at most 190 mV; PSRR at 1 kHz of at least 73 dB; residual ringing (peak-to-peak) 7-10 us after each load step of at most 10 mV.

Design a voltage-controlled oscillator in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: control voltage range 0.7-1.4 V. Requirements: oscillation frequency at the mid control voltage of at least 400 MHz; output swing of at least 1.24 V; total power consumption (including the reference current) of at most 1.4 mW; tuning ratio fmax/fmin of at least 20.

Design a voltage-controlled oscillator in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: control voltage range 0.7-1.4 V. Requirements: oscillation frequency at the mid control voltage of at least 720 MHz; total power consumption (including the reference current) of at most 190 uW; tuning ratio fmax/fmin of at least 19; output swing of at least 1.03 V.

Design a voltage-controlled oscillator in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: control voltage range 0.7-1.4 V. Requirements: oscillation frequency at the mid control voltage of at least 1.3 GHz; output swing of at least 1.61 V; total power consumption (including the reference current) of at most 2.6 mW; tuning ratio fmax/fmin of at least 3.2.
